description: nhflow_2d_susp_flume with 5 instead of 20 layers: the bottom cell is 20 reference heights thick (a = 0.01 h). Pick-up at the reference level (bedconc_VR: cbe the mean of the Rouse profile over the bottom cell, rbe; nhflow_suspended_IM1::suspsource: E - D = ws/rbe (cbe - c_0)), exponentially fitted vertical flux and the bottom cell coupled through its near-bed profile (settling_fit). Depth-mean concentration at 38 m after 150 s for 5 / 10 / 20 / 40 / 80 layers: 0.43 / 0.44 / 0.45 / 0.46 / 0.42e-4 (Rouse equilibrium 0.42e-4); before 0.13 / 0.22 / 0.40 / 0.71 / 0.56e-4 (Dropbox/Claude/Exner Review/validation/06_nhflow_fixes_261111).
covers: nhflow_suspended_IM1::suspsource with wsx = ws/rbe on a coarse vertical grid
